title: It Does What a Small Vacuum Should
text:
It Does What a Small Vacuum Should. Vacuum cleaners are a household essential. We have a few in my house; two larger ones and now one smaller one, the Black and Decker Dustbuster Cordless Lithium Hand Vacuum.

I was attracted to this vacuum mainly due to its size. A small vacuum is very handy for small jobs and the first thing that came to mind when I saw this vacuum was its use in my car. It’s small enough to handle vacuuming a small vehicle and the narrow nozzle would be good, I reasoned, to suck up small particles between the seats and in other tight spaces.

After using this vacuum in my car, I quickly learned a few things. One is the weak suction- other reviewers have made this point and it’s very true. There isn’t enough suction here to pick up very many things. This limits the vacuum’s usefulness, but then again, it’s only a small hand held vacuum so expectations need to be kept in check. Another issue I have is with the charge- it only lasted me about 20 minutes so don’t be surprised if you have to reach for the cord sooner than later.

With the waste and filter, I do like that it’s easy to unscrew, dump the waste, and remove and clean the filter. You don’t need to purchase small bags, which is nice. And it’s easy to see when the container is getting too full because this section is made from clear, see through plastic. Even if you couldn’t see it, you would know the container is full because the suction reduces to almost nothing. Oh, and it does have an attached, flip up brush which is good for vacuuming furniture.

So, after using the Black and Decker Dustbuster Cordless Lithium Hand Vacuum what is my final verdict? I like it, but I have a few reservations. It would be nice if it held a charge for a longer period of time and it would be great if it had a little more sucking power. Then again, this is a small, handheld vacuum so it isn’t fair to judge it by comparing to a full size vacuum. Taken as a whole, it’s good for what it does and it has proven itself handy for keeping my small car free from debris.

product_metadata.title: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster Handheld Vacuum, Cordless, Ink Blue (HHVI325JR22)
features: Dustbowl capacity 13 Ounces; Lithium technology provides strong suction and extended run time, 2.5 Amp Hours
Translucent, washable bowl and washable filter
Crevice tool for hard to reach areas and flip up brush for upholstery
Cyclonic action helps keep the filter clean and suction strong
description: The black+decker HHVI325JR22 Dust buster cordless lithium hand vacuum, ink Blue, is ideal for picking up dirt and debris in your everyday life. The lithium technology provides strong suction and extended run time. It has a washable bowl (20.6Oz) and filter which allows for thorough cleaning between Jobs. The translucent, bagless dirt bowl makes it easy to see dirt and easy to empty. This vac has a rotating nozzle for a comfortable hand position when accessing hard to reach areas, along with an extendable crevice tool that provides access to hard to reach areas and a flip-up brush which allows you to dust and vacuum upholstery. The cyclonic action helps to keep the filter clean and suction strong. 2.5 Amp hours. This vac has a lightweight and portable design which makes for convenient cleaning. A wall mount provides a versatile storage solution. Includes: hand vac, Jack plug charger, wall mount, extendable crevice tool, flip-up brush.
